name: @prism/ui
description: Shared React Map and explorer UI

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun run build:css && bun run build:icons
scripts.build:css: bun -e "await Bun.write('dist/tokens.css', await Bun.file('src/tokens.css').text()); await Bun.write('dist/map.css', await Bun.file('src/map.css').text())"
scripts.build:icons: mkdir -p dist/icons/files && cp src/icons/file-type-sprite.svg dist/icons/ && cp -R src/icons/files/. dist/icons/files/
